evidence.finding: VIP award UI reads selfPlayer.vipAwards; 1 means claimed; sends MID657 {id=level}; on successful awards calls SelfPlayer:handleRewards and marks vipAwards[level]=1 locally.
VIP gift/red-point selection scans vipAwards for eligible zero-valued claim states.
PlayerInfo hydration assigns params.vip_awards; handleRewards consumes award rows with table_id/item_num.
VIP1..VIP15 each expose reward_item gift IDs.
Referenced VIP reward gifts resolve to item stacks plus Crystal values.
Client reward handling routes table_id/item_num through Backpack display/update conventions; scalar currency remains represented by asset IDs in award UI.

backend_decisions: Canonical vip_awards is exactly 15 literal integer 0/1 values, indexed VIP1..VIP15.
MID657 uses source gift tables; no invented reward contents.
Crystal commits through EconomyLedger and stack items through typed RewardTransactionService in the same UoW as the claim marker.
Duplicate claim returns awards=[] without a second reward commit.
No MID116 or unrelated VIP domain implementation in Pass91.
